title: TensorPlate Bundle Manifest (V01-E08 verification subset)
description: Minimal manifest envelope consumed by the V01-E08 deploy-time bundle verifier. The full authoring surface for every model class lands in V01-E13; this subset captures only the fields the agent needs to verify integrity, format compatibility, runtime/hardware compatibility, declared backend availability, and capability requirements before staging. V01-E13 is free to add fields without bumping the bundle format version as long as it keeps the listed fields stable.

name.description: Human-readable bundle name. Distinct from `bundle_id` (digest-derived) and from `deployment_id` (assigned by the operator at deploy time).

format_version.description: On-disk bundle format version. The agent rejects bundles with a major-version higher than the runtime supports, and refuses bundles older than the documented minimum.

backend_hint.description: Declared execution backend. The runtime rejects unknown or unavailable backends with `Error::Code::Unsupported`; it does not fall back heuristically.

artifacts.description: Files inside the bundle the runtime needs to load. v0.1.0 always expects exactly one `model` artifact; additional roles (`tokenizer`, `calibration`, `vitis_calibration`, etc.) are reserved.

path.description: Path inside the bundle root, e.g., `model.engine` or `state_dict.pt`. Must not escape the bundle root.

digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the artifact file (e.g., `sha256:cafebabe...`).

byte_size.description: Optional byte size of the artifact for diagnostics.

target_hardware.description: Hardware compatibility envelope. v0.1.0 honors `device_family` and `memory_estimate_bytes`; further fields are reserved for V01-E13.

min_memory_bytes.description: Minimum free device/system memory required, in bytes. The agent rejects the bundle if the device cannot meet this value.

memory_estimate_bytes.description: Expected working-set memory in bytes. Used for capacity_checked phase decisions.

runtime_compatibility.description: Inclusive runtime version range the bundle author tested against. The agent rejects bundles whose range excludes the local runtime version.

capability_requirements.description: Backend capability flags the bundle requires. Reserved boolean shape; the agent checks against the configured backend capability map (V01-E05).

manifest_digest.description: Optional self-digest. When present, the agent computes the digest of the canonical manifest with this field stripped and compares them. Bundles that omit this field are accepted only when the deploy request supplies an out-of-band expected digest.
